test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ravi sold a chair at a loss of 40%. The selling price of the chair is Rs. 900. What is the cost price of the chair?
solution:
**Given:**

Ravi sold a chair at a loss of 40%.

The selling price of the chair is Rs. 900.

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price × (100 - Loss)%

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Cost price × 60% = 900

⇒ Cost price = 900 × (100/60)

⇒ Cost price = 1500

**∴ The cost price of the chair is Rs. 1500.**
